limitations: Manual seed boxes are diagnostic selections, not semantic or identity GT.
Original observations did not persist cycle errors; magnitudes are separately labelled replay from source-verified frozen caches.
Both-tracked but unsupported anchor implies raw RoMa gate rejection only by the recorded formula; the precise subgate was not saved.
No asynchronous same-frame epipolar filtering, new tracking, model inference or optimization occurs.
Accepted three-camera seed observations need not have synchronous physical exposure. Valid supported 3D is a pipeline claim, not independently verified real accuracy.
